headlines.title: Chrissy Metz on Why She's Taking GLP-1 After Initial Skepticism
headlines.description: Chrissy Metz joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to talk about her journey with GLP-1s and becoming a spokesperson for Ro. She opens up about struggling with her weight as a child, dealing with "food noise," and making healthy changes to her lifestyle. She shares how GLP-1s have improved her life and says she “wouldn’t be able to do 8 shows a week” without them. Then, she talks about having a supportive partner and the 10 year anniversary of “This Is Us.”

headlines.title: Tips to Handle Back-to-School Anxiety for Students and Parents
headlines.description: Going back to school can be anxiety-inducing for kids, so licensed professional counselors and New York Times bestselling authors Sissy Goff and David Thomas give some helpful advice to ease the transition. They share their three step plan to manage back-to-school anxiety, which includes emphasizing that “nervous is normal,” teaching your kids how to “avoid avoidance,” and what to do when anxiety strikes in the classroom.

headlines.title: Is Milk More Hydrating Than Water? Experts Weigh In
headlines.description: From how much water you need to the hype around electrolytes, NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar and nutrition expert Joy Bauer stop by TODAY to break down the dos and don'ts of hydration. They share their best advice, including how many cups of water you should drink a day, how to make your own electrolyte drink, and more.

headlines.title: What to Know About Frozen Shoulder: Symptoms, Treatment, More
headlines.description: Frozen shoulder condition affects mostly women and makes everyday tasks like washing your hair impossible. Dr. Jocelyn Wittstein, orthopedic surgeon and sports medicine specialist at Duke, joins TODAY to share everything you need to know from warning signs, treatment options and more.

headlines.title: This popular Bissell vacuum is nearly $120 off at Walmart
headlines.description: The Bissell PowerForce Pet XL upright carpet cleaner is nearly 50 percent off at Walmart. See why more than 6,300 reviewers rate it 4.3 stars for pet messes.

headlines.title: The best acne treatments for teens
headlines.description: Dermatologists share the best acne treatments for teens, including cleansers, spot treatments and over-the-counter products for clearer skin.

headlines.title: The best wireless earbuds of 2026
headlines.description: I tested more than 50 wireless earbuds to select our top picks. Shop brands like Apple, Beats, Bose and more.

headlines.title: Where to find NIOSH-approved N95 masks right now
headlines.description: NIOSH-approved N95 respirators are the most protective type of face mask, according to the CDC. Doctors explain how to shop for them.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.

headlines.title: How 3 health factors can help delay dementia for up to 13 years
headlines.description: New research from NYU Langone Health found that people who avoid three vascular risk factors in middle age had about 13 more dementia-free years.

headlines.title: Michigan says salad is safe again as state’s cyclosporiasis cases fall
headlines.description: The state health department said residents can resume buying bagged salads but should still avoid recalled lettuce.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños at Chipotle and Qdoba expands to 27 states
headlines.description: Chipotle and Qdoba say they have removed the jalapeños from their restaurants.
